complaint_text: Waterlogging after overnight heavy rain; water is accumulating across the carriageway near the market entrance.
Drain overflow has pushed stagnant rainwater onto the roadside and pedestrians are forced into traffic.
Vehicles are moving slowly because standing water covers one lane after the morning rainfall.
Water has entered the frontage of two shops following intense rainfall and the drain appears unable to clear it.
A blocked roadside inlet is holding water even though the rain has stopped.
Before the forecast rain, the same low section of Baner Road is already collecting water around the drain opening.
Heavy rain has started and runoff from the side lane is flowing toward the same low point on Baner Road.
Standing water is again covering the left lane and traffic is being diverted around the flooded section.
Water remained on the road after rain overnight; local residents report that this happens repeatedly.
Drain near the low point is overflowing again and muddy water is spreading toward the footpath.
Pedestrian movement is unsafe because the footpath is submerged and people are walking beside moving vehicles.
Water is backing up from the roadside drain and reaching the entrance of nearby commercial properties.
Forecast rain is expected this morning; residents are concerned about the known low point that flooded last month.
Intense rainfall has caused water to pool at the same road depression and vehicles are slowing sharply.
The roadside drain is receiving runoff but water is not clearing quickly, causing repeated ponding.
Standing water has spread across the carriageway and traffic congestion is building near the junction.
The road is still wet and partially waterlogged the morning after rain; residents say the issue has returned multiple times this monsoon.
A drain inlet close to the junction appears blocked with debris and water is collecting around it.
Bus and two-wheelers are taking turns through standing water because the affected lane remains partially blocked.
Water has reached the edge of a nearby commercial entrance and pedestrians are reporting repeated flooding at this location.
